name_reason: Already compliant: game global -> data_fd2_ prefix; battle-core cursor state -> data_fd2_battle_*; descriptor cursor_screen_x reflects role (cursor column within the on-screen viewport). The trailing 'x' is an axis label, NOT a Ghidra address residue (0x53ab9 != ...x). Datatype is reflected as a scalar coordinate; name is correct.
purpose: Runtime battle-cursor screen-relative X (cursor column within the 13-tile-wide viewport).
logic_summary: Mutable BSS state at 0x53AB9 (dword, every access is dword ptr [0x53AB9]). Equals cursor_world_x - view_window_origin_x. Zero at load; first set by engine init / save-load via MOVZX byte->dword from the map header (writer fd2_load_save_and_init_engine @ 0x1040c), cleared/seeded by chapter init (fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter @ 0x20641) and chapter-end / intro-setup handlers. Then INC/DEC by the cursor-move handlers (fd2_cursor_move_left/right) and walk-step handlers (fd2_walk_step_left/right) as the cursor or a walking char traverses the map; when the cursor reaches the viewport edge and triggers a scroll, screen_x stays at the edge value while world_x and origin_x both advance. Consumed by render/HUD passes and dialog-open animation to position the cursor highlight / slide-in.
element_semantics: Single signed scalar: cursor column relative to the viewport's left edge, normally 0..viewport_max (~0xC). Goes NEGATIVE at the map left edge: once view_window_origin_x hits 0 the walk-step/move scroll branch is bypassed (origin_x==0 guard fails) and the inner branch keeps decrementing screen_x past 0. Signed access confirmed by SIGNED branches at the readers (fd2_cursor_move_right @ 0x11c12: CMP dword ptr [0x53ab9],0xa; JLE).
